snippet.title: NEW Action Rogue : Work in Progress (yeah that's the name). Try out the DEMO on steam !
snippet.description:
Work In Progress On Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684550/Work_In_Progress/
Discord : https://discord.gg/dePcubrXQM

Trailer by : Nathan Diolot
Musics by : Julien Ramirez
Game by : Maxence Jacquot

It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your cotract. Now go fire some people.
